tooltip.ceiling: Generate ceilings supported by the current project format.

canvas.title: 2.5D Isometric Canvas
canvas.help: Left click twice: draw wall. Right click: cancel. Middle drag: pan. Wheel: zoom.
canvas.help_placing: Left click: place decoration. Right click: stop placing and switch to Select.

status.language_saved: Language saved: {language_name}. Restart to apply it fully.
message.language_changed: Language has been changed to {language_name}. Restart Auto Mapper to apply it fully.
